evaluation_levels.quote: Gross level – likelihood and impact without additional, specific mitigation action.
Actual level - this is the current likelihood and impact, based on mitigation action already put in place
Expected level – this is a future level of likelihood and impact based on any additional mitigation action (if any) planned

The Council evaluates its identified risks on a five-point scale on the likelihood or probability of the risk occurring (rated between rare and certain) and the impact caused should the risk occur (rated between negligible and critical).
The risk score is, therefore, based on a ‘reasonable worst case scenario’.

scoring_method.notes: Strategy 4.2 describes a five-point likelihood and five-point impact scale (Tables 1 and 2). Figure 1 (5x5 matrix, p18) gives a label per likelihood x impact cell; Table 4 (p19) gives bands by score with escalation and response. Figure 4 (p21) gives register membership. Records only; no score applied. Inconsistencies between these parts are in discrepancies.

gaps.what: Agreed audit actions/recommendations with due dates and status (open/overdue) are not in the papers; only follow-up implementation-progress opinions (recorded under follow_ups).
Strategic / Corporate Risk Register not public: strategy states risk is reported as a Part II (confidential information) report to the Governance Committee.

evidence.quote: risk is reported as a Part II (confidential information) report to the Governance Committee

evidence.quote: Appendix D - Internal Audit Plan 2025 to 2028

gaps.what: Definitions of each assurance opinion label (Substantial, Reasonable, Limited, Weak, Satisfactory, Unsatisfactory, Advisory) are not given; the NOTE only says how an opinion is derived.
Follow-up status of open recommendations: the End of December 2025 report records follow-ups as 'None'; no recommendation-level status in any paper.
No audit of procurement-card or purchasing-card spend, or other purchasing spend beyond Contract Letting and Accounts Payable, appears in the completed-work tables.

Table 1 impact scale cells for 'Personal', 'Assets', 'Reputation' and 'Compliance' columns are not recorded item-by-item; only the label and financial column per level are quoted (plain text separates the columns).
